candidates.readme_excerpt:
ai-phone

An AI phone agent that runs on your computer.

Documentation · Architecture · AGPL-3.0

![ai-phone setup running in a terminal](docs/assets/setup.png) ### Installation | Requirement | Details | |---|---| | Platform | macOS on Apple Silicon. Intel Macs, Linux and Windows are not currently supported. | | Memory | 16 GB recommended for the default 4B model; 32 GB for 9B. Setup also offers a smaller 2B model for 8 GB systems. | | Dependencies | Git, [Homebrew](https://brew.sh) and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). The installer handles Python packages and the native SIP library. | | Storage | Several GB for model downloads, depending on the models selected. Setup checks available disk space. | | Phone connection | A SIP address for direct calls, or your own SIP trunk, Telnyx or Twilio account for telephone numbers. Carrier charges apply. | ```bash git clone https://github.com/oxnw/ai-phone.git cd ai-phone ./scripts/install.sh uv run ai-phone setup ``` Setup lets you choose incoming calls, outgoing calls, or both, then configures the model, line and voice. It recommends a local model based on detected RAM and downloads the required weights. Use `uv run ai-phone setup --plain` for plain prompts. The current speech backends use MLX on Apple Silicon, even when a cloud model handles the conversation. Supporting Linux or Windows would require different speech backends and changes to installation and platform integration. The platform requirement applies to the computer running ai-phone; callers can use any phone or SIP client. ### Usage Start the daemon after setup: ```bash uv run ai-phone run ``` Keep it running while you want to receive calls. For outgoing calls only, start it when needed and stop it with Ctrl-C afterward. Setup does not install a background service. From another terminal in the repo, give the phone agent instructions for a call: ```bash uv run ai-phone call +15555550100 --json \ --prompt "Ask whether they have a table for two at eight tonight." ``` Replace the example number with the number you want to call. The command returns the transcript when the call ends. Every outgoing call starts with an AI disclosure. Incoming calls use the greeting and instructions you set during setup. candidates.description: Maya TTS: streaming Indic + English text-to-speech (inference engine)
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Maya2 TTS

Streaming multilingual text-to-speech for **11 Indic languages and English**, with 20 built-in voices and
zero-shot voice cloning. This repository is the **inference engine**: a continuous-batching CUDA-graph engine, a
Python API, an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server and a WebSocket streaming server. The weights are on Hugging Face at
**[maya-research/maya2-native](https://huggingface.co/maya-research/maya2-native)**.

**[Samples](https://huggingface.co/maya-research/maya2-native#samples) · [Model card](https://huggingface.co/maya-research/maya2-native) · [Engine docs](docs/ENGINE.md) · [Text normaliser](maya3/text/README.md)**

> The Python package and model are called **Maya3**; `maya2-native` is the repository name.

- **Languages:** as bn en gu hi kn ml mr or pa ta te.
- **Streaming:** about 14 ms to first audio at B=1 on an H100. One H100 NVL serves **224 concurrent streams** at **323 s of audio per second**, with steady-state TTFA p99 **242 ms** and 0 playback stalls.
- **Voices:** 20 named voices (`voice="Ahana"`), or clone a voice from 3-10 s of audio.
- **Text normaliser (bundled):** numbers, currency, dates, URLs and ALL-CAPS names are spoken correctly in every language.

## Install

You need Python 3.10-3.12, Linux and an NVIDIA GPU with a CUDA 12.8 driver (8 GB or more of GPU memory).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MayaResearch/maya2-native maya3 && cd maya3
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[server]" --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
```

The pinned runtime is torch 2.8.0 (cu128, triton 3.4.0), transformers 5.6.2 and speechbrain 1.1.2. Weights, the
Mimi codec and the ECAPA speaker encoder are downloaded from Hugging Face on first use. Set `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` to
use only the local cache.

## Quickstart

### Python

```python
from maya3 import Maya3TTS
import soundfile as sf

tts = Maya3TTS.from_pretrained("maya-research/maya2-native", max_seats=16)

wav = tts.generate("नमस्ते, आपका ऑर्डर कल पहुँच जाएगा।", lang="hi", voice="Ahana")
sf.write("out.wav", wav, 24000)                       # float32, 24 kHz mono

for pcm in tts.stream("Your OTP is 482913.", lang="en", voice="Siddhant", normalize=True):
    ...                                                # int16 PCM chunks, as they are generated
```

`generate`, `stream` and `astream` are thread-safe and asyncio-safe. Concurrent calls are batched on the GPU.

### Command line

```bash
python examples/synthesize.py "నమస్కారం, మీరు ఎలా

# Codex SEO 简体中文 | [English](README.en.md) 在 [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex) 里免费、开源地做 SEO 审计。 > **出处：** Codex SEO 移植自 Agrici Daniel 的 [claude-seo](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo)（MIT 协议）。审计方法论、技能与脚本的功劳属于上游项目及其贡献者，本仓库将其适配到 Codex CLI 运行。完整的版权与贡献者信息见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 和 [CONTRIBUTORS.md](CONTRIBUTORS.md)。

给它任何一个网站，它会跑一次完整的 SEO 审计，然后交给你一份按优先级排好序的行动计划。它检查的内容和一个合格的 SEO 顾问一样： - **技术 SEO**：可抓取性、收录、sitemap、robots.txt、重定向、页面速度和 Core Web Vitals - **内容质量**：E-E-A-T（经验、专业、权威、可信）、薄页面、主题覆盖 - **结构化数据**：发现、校验并生成 Schema.org 标记 - **AI 搜索（GEO）**：你的页面被 Google AI Overviews、AI Mode、ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 引用的可能性 - **本地与电商 SEO**：Google Business Profile、评价、地图包、商品页和多语言站点 Codex SEO 由 26 个子技能和 19 个专家角色剧本组成。一次完整审计会依次走过每个分析角色（技术、内容、结构化数据、速度、AI 搜索等），每个角色的发现都会落盘留证。每条建议都会说明它为什么重要、你怎么验证它生效。 ## 安装 需要带 skills 支持的 [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex)，以及 Python 3.11 到 3.14。 ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zhtyyx/codex-seo.git bash codex-seo/install.sh ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zhtyyx/codex-seo.git powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File codex-seo\install.ps1 ``` 安装器会把技能复制到 `~/.agents/skills/`（Codex 从这里发现用户技能），并创建带无头浏览器的隔离 Python 运行时。不碰系统全局环境，卸载用 `bash uninstall.sh`。 **第一次审计：** ```bash codex # 启动 Codex CLI $seo audit https://example.com # 全站审计，输出按优先级排好的行动计划 $seo page https://example.com/pricing # 单页深度分析 $seo geo https://example.com # AI 搜索就绪度 $seo schema https://example.com # 检测并生成结构化数据 ``` ## 命令 在 Codex CLI 里用 `$` 提及技能即可调用，例如 `$seo audit https://example.com`（自然语言说「帮我做一次 SEO 审计，网址是 …」也可以）。主要命令组：
审计与规划
  • $seo setup：创建或刷新隔离 Python 运

Web service and CLI tool for SEO site audit: crawl site, lighthouse all pages, view public reports in browser. Also output to console, json, csv.

Web view report - [json-viewer](https://json-viewer.popstas.pro/).

Demo:

Русское описание [ниже](#русский)

![site-audit-demo](assets/site-audit-demo.gif)

## Using without install
Open https://json-viewer.popstas.pro/. Public server allow to scan up to 100 pages at once.

## Features:
- Crawls the entire site, collects links to pages and documents
- Does not follow links outside the scanned domain (configurable)
- Analyse each page with Lighthouse (see below)
- Analyse main page text with Mozilla Readability and Yake
- Search pages with SSL mixed content
- Scan list of urls, `--url-list`
- Set default report fields and filters
- Scan presets
- Documents with the extensions `doc`,` docx`, `xls`,` xlsx`, `ppt`,` pptx`, `pdf`,` rar`, `zip` are added to the list with a depth == 0

## Technical details:
- Does not load images, css, js (configurable)
- Each site is saved to a file with a domain name in `~/site-audit-seo/`
- Some URLs are ignored ([`preRequest` in `src/scrap-site.js`](src/scrap-site.js#L98))

### Web viewer features:
- Fixed table header and url column
- Add/remove columns
- Column presets
- Field groups by categories
- Filters presets (ex. `h1_count != 1`)
- Color validation
- Verbose page details (`+` button)
- Direct URL to same report with selected fields, filters, sort
- Stats for whole scanned pages, validation summary
- Persistent URL to report when `--upload` using
- Switch between last uploaded reports
- Rescan current report

- description

# Chrome DevTools for agents

[![npm chrome-devtools-mcp package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/chrome-devtools-mcp.svg)](https://npmjs.org/package/chrome-devtools-mcp)

Chrome DevTools for agents (`chrome-devtools-mcp`) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot)
control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a
Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a [CLI][cli]. Both give your AI
coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable
automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.

[Tool reference][tool-reference] | [CLI][cli] | [Skills][skills] | [Changelog][changelog] | [Contributing][contributing] | [Troubleshooting][troubleshooting] | [Design Principles][design-principles]

## Key features

- **Get performance insights**: Uses [Chrome
  DevTools](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend) to record
  traces and extract actionable performance insights.
- **Advanced browser debugging**: Analyze network requests, take screenshots and
  check browser console messages (with source-mapped stack traces).
- **Reliable automation**. Uses
  [puppeteer](https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer) to automate actions in
  Chrome and automatically wait for action results.

## Disclaimers

`chrome-devtools-mcp` exposes content of the browser instance to the MCP clients
allowing them to inspect, debug, and modify any data in the browser or DevTools.
Avoid sharing sensitive or personal information that you don't want to share with
MCP clients.

`chrome-devtools-mcp` officially supports Google Chrome and [Chrome for Testing](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/chrome-for-testing/) only.
Other Chromium-based browsers may work, but this is not guaranteed, and you may encounter unexpected behavior. Use at your own discretion.
We are committed to providing fixes and support for the latest version of [Extended Stable Chrome](https://chromiumdash.appspot.com/schedule).

Performance tools may send trace URLs to the Google CrUX API to fetch real-user
experience data. This helps provide a holistic performance picture by
presenting field data alongside lab data. This data is collected by the [Chrome
User Experience Report (CrUX)](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/crux). To disable
this, run with the `--no-performance-crux` flag.

# Impeccable

Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 62 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design.

> **Quick start:** From your project root, run `npx impeccable install`, then run `/impeccable init` inside your AI coding tool. Full docs: [impeccable.style](https://impeccable.style).

## Why Impeccable?

Anthropic's [frontend-design](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design) was the first widely-used design skill for Claude. Impeccable started from there.

Every model trained on the same SaaS templates. Skip the guidance and you get the same handful of tells on every project: Inter for everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, the rounded-square icon tile above every heading.

Impeccable adds:
- **One setup flow.** `/impeccable init` records durable product truth in `PRODUCT.md`, so later commands know the audience, purpose, operating context, constraints, voice, and evidence without confusing those facts with surface-level visual direction.
- **24 commands.** A shared design vocabulary with your AI: `polish`, `audit`, `critique`, `distill`, `animate`, `bolder`, `quieter`, and more.
- **62 deterministic detector rules** plus LLM-only critique checks. The CLI and browser extension run the deterministic rules with no LLM and no API key.

## What's Included

### The Skill: impeccable

The skill installs as one command:

```bash
/impeccable <command> <target>
```

Start every new project with:

```bash
/impeccable init
```

`init` inspects the project, asks only for material gaps in durable product truth, and writes `PRODUCT.md`. Visitor mode and visual direction are chosen later for each surface; incumbent or newly built visual systems are recorded separately in `DESIGN.md`.

### 24 Commands

All commands are accessed through `/impeccable`:

| `/impeccable extract` | Pull reusable components and tokens into the design system |
| `/impeccable shape` | Plan UX/UI before writing code |

Top episodes: **651K / 546K / 346K views**. > This repo is that whole workflow packed into one skill, including every mistake that cost me credits along the way. --- ## What it does - **Series bible, not one-off prompts.** Cast, art style, voices, locations and running gags live in `series.json`. Episode 30 looks like episode 1. - **Hook first.** Before writing anything, the agent pitches 3 premises with one pick, based on formulas ranked by real views (fake-out that fails, transformation, catchphrase ×3, "wants it, can't admit it"…). - **Per-second shot scripts.** Each ≤15 s clip gets a shot list with action, in-character dialogue, SFX and camera for every shot, assembled into a long structured prompt. The prompt restates every design detail, so hair and outfits don't drift. - **Validated before a single credit is spent.** `build_prompt.py` refuses to build if a sheet ID is missing, a placeholder is left, a shot has no camera, or timings don't add up. - **Cost gate.** The agent quotes clips · seconds · credits · balance, waits for your "yes", generates clip 1 for you to check, *then* batches the rest. - **QA every clip.** Character match against the sheets, burned-in subtitles, voice gender and language, story logic. A failed clip is regenerated whole, never patched. - **Edit that survives Instagram.** One-pass re-encode with every clip normalised (AI clips joined with `-c copy` get segments dropped by IG), 1080p, optional BGM bed and watermark, −14 LUFS, and a contact sheet of every cut for you to check. - **Cover + caption.** The cover is generated with the character sheets as references, so faces match. 9:16 with the title in Instagram's 3:4 grid safe zone, plus a crop preview. candidates.description: Cut the tokens Claude Code loads at session start. CLI that sets up a small CLAUDE.md with on-demand docs, measures startup tokens, and keeps them small.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Claude Token Optimizer ![Claude Code startup drops from about 11,000 tokens to about 800, 93% less](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nadimtuhin/claude-token-optimizer/main/docs/images/hero.svg) **Claude rereads everything.** Every session. You pay each time. `★ 600+` [`npm`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-token-optimizer) [`MIT`](LICENSE) `Node 20+`

Mine was 11,000 tokens per session. Open 20 sessions a day and that is 220,000 tokens gone before you type a word. That is money, usage limits, and room Claude could have used for your code.
![Fix it in two lines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nadimtuhin/claude-token-optimizer/main/docs/images/h-fix.svg) Open a terminal in your project folder and paste each line as is. Inside Claude Code, type `!` first, then paste. **0. Keep a copy of your notes, just in case:** ```bash cp CLAUDE.md CLAUDE.md.mine ``` **1. See what Claude rereads every session:** ```bash npx -y claude-token-optimizer measure ``` **2. Shrink it:** ```bash npx -y claude-token-optimizer prune --yes ``` Old session notes and finished task lists move into side files Claude opens only when needed. You get a line like `✓ Saved ~3414 tokens`. Run step 1 again to see your new total. Says "Nothing to prune"? Use the Claude Code prompt below instead. **Rather not type commands?** Paste this into Claude Code: ``` Back up my CLAUDE.md, then set up github.com/nadimtuhin/claude-token-optimizer by following its AGENTS.md. Show me the token count before and after. ```
![What just happened](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nadimtuhin/claude-token-optimizer/main/docs/images/h-what.svg) **Claude reads in tokens.** Small pieces of text. Before, every session reread all your project notes, piece by piece. **Now it gets a cheat sheet.** A short file at the start. Everything else waits in files Claude opens only when it needs them. ![Big docs go through this tool and become a small always-loaded cheat sheet plus on-demand files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nadimtuhin/claude-token-optimizer/main/docs/images/how-it-works.svg) Nothing about how you use Claude changes. Each session just starts lighter.
![Where the tokens went](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nadimtuhin/claude-token-optimizer/main/docs/images/h-where.svg) **My project, before and after.** Claude still finds the old notes when it needs them. It just stops rereading them every session. ![Startup tokens before

--- ## 📖 项目简介 **Story Studio（故事工坊）** 是专为 AI Agent（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等支持 Skill 的智能体）打造的一站式短视频内容创作技能包。 做历史或人物故事类短视频，往往要在**找选题、查史料、磨开头钩子、写口播稿、配音、对齐时间轴、拆分数十个分镜、保持AI生图画风一致、以及在剪映里一帧帧打关键帧做推拉运镜**之间反复横跳。 **Story Studio 把这一整套工业化流水线装进了一个 Skill 里：** ```mermaid flowchart LR A[💡 选题与黄金钩子] --> B[✍️ 口播文案定稿] B --> C[🎙️ 豆包语音大模型 / 自备配音] C --> D[⏱️ Coli 本地转录对齐] D --> E[🎨 3大画风分镜与配图] E --> F[🎞️ 剪映专业版草稿导出] ``` - **不需要从头拼凑多个散装 Skill**：内部已深度整合写作、配音、语音识别、视觉分镜与剪映工程生成。 - **随时中断与接力**：你可以只让它写稿改钩子；也可以丢给它一篇现成文稿和一段你自己录好的 MP3 放进文件夹，让 Agent 直接读取并接力完成后续的字幕时间戳对齐、配图和剪映草稿编排。 --- ## ✨ 核心亮点 - 🧠 **内置双王牌写作 Skill + 370+ 篇爆款对标文案库**：拒绝 AI 味大纲文！内置经过深度蒸馏的「历史叙事」与「真实人物故事/女性传奇」两套完整 Writing-DNA，涵盖选题策略、黄金 3 秒开头钩子库、句式节奏与史实核查机制。 - 🎨 **三套成熟配图画风 + 内置成品参考图库**：支持 **历史写实风**、**厚涂历史漫画风**、**黑白纪实叙事风**。内置高水准正文与封面参考图（Reference Images），生图时自动对照材质与光影，告别跨镜头画风漂移与年代穿帮。 - 🎙️ **双路径灵活配音 + 本地高精度时间戳对齐**：推荐直接接入 **豆包语音大模型（V3 双向流式）** 一键合成高表现力旁白；也支持**将自己提前准备好的配音 MP3 放入项目文件夹让 Agent 直接读取**。配合本地 **Coli（基于 sherpa-onnx）** 离线识别生成精准到字句的 SRT 时间轴，绝不按字数瞎猜时间。 - 🎞️ **真正可二次编辑的剪映专业版草稿**：基于 `pyJianYingDraft` 直接生成剪映工程文件。自动将 9:16 竖屏图片、完整配音铺上时间轴，并**自动写入覆盖全镜的慢推拉关键帧与切点冲击缩放（Punch Zoom）**，打开剪映即可预览微调并导出成片。 - ⚡ **零门槛自动环境初始化**：无需手动折腾 Python、Node.js、FFmpeg 或语音识别环境。首次调用时，告诉 Agent 一键配置，即可在用户独立数据目录完成便携环境搭建。 --- ## 🛠️ 四大核心模块详解 ### 1️⃣ 文稿创作：双风格 Writing-DNA + 370+ 篇对标文案库 不只是简单地让大模型“写篇故事”，Story Studio 内置了两个完整的专业级写作子模块，提炼自数百篇视频号与短视频平台的高赞爆款逐字稿： | 内置写作风格 | 适用赛道与特点 | 内置语料与 DNA 武器库 | |

candidates.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs. - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems. - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer. - Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. Learn: fold certified corrections and usage back into the ontology, so shared context improves with every question. ## Benchmarks To run a text-to-SQL benchmark such as BIRD, refer to the [ontology SQL evaluation repository](https://github.com/NVIDIA/ontology-sql-eval/). > **Licensing & contributions.** Auto Ontology is distributed under the > [Apache License 2.0](./LICENSE). Third-party open-source components > bundled, linked, or otherwise used by this project are listed in > [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). **This project > is currently not accepting external contributions.**

## Key Features - **Natural-language querying** of structured data — questions are translated to SQL and executed against connected databases, powered by NVIDIA NIM. - **Semantic catalog / ontology layer** over relational sources, stored in Postgres alongside the catalog it describes. - **Authentication & RBAC** —using [Better Auth](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth). - **Web UI** for chat, analysis, data catalog, analytics, and settings. - **Flexible deployment** — Helm chart for Kubernetes or Docker Compose for a local stack. ## Software Components

candidates.readme_excerpt:
AutoSwarm: All Your Agents, Working as One

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) **Unify your agents. Unify your context. Work as One** [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-arXiv-B31B1B?style=flat&logo=arxiv&logoColor=white)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33048) [![Feishu](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feishu-Group-E9DBFC?style=flat)](./COMMUNICATION.md) [![WeChat](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat-Group-C5EAB4?style=flat&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](./COMMUNICATION.md)
## Why AutoSwarm? **No single agent can do everything. You don’t need another agent—you need all your agents working as one.** Different agents come with different: - 🛠️ **Capabilities** — coding, research, browsing, office work, writing, computer use, and social networking; - 🧠 **Context and Memory** — each agent maintains its own context, with little or no sharing across agents; - ⚙️ **Tools and Workflows** — each agent follows its own interaction patterns and execution process; - 🌐 **Data and Application Ecosystems** — agents are connected to different platforms, services, files, and data. Today, you are forced to switch interfaces, repeat information, coordinate subtasks, and manually combine results. **AutoSwarm turns fragmented agents into one coordinated team.** Give AutoSwarm a task once. It unifies all your agents into one coordinated team: - **Selects the right agents** based on their capabilities; - **Shares context and memory** across agents; - **Connects complementary tools** and workflows; - **Bridges data** and application ecosystems; - **Runs tasks in parallel** for faster execution; - **Coordinates agent collaboration** and keeps everyone aligned; - **Verifies and synthesizes results** into one coherent answer.
## 🤖 Agents AutoSwarm Can Call

candidates.readme_excerpt: # yoinks yoink any video. paste. yoink. done. Download videos from YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and 1,800+ other sites — right from your terminal. Paste a url, pick a resolution (or audio-only mp3), done. No popups, no fake download buttons, no sketchy redirects. ## Install ```sh npm install -g yoinks ``` Or try it without installing anything: ```sh npx yoinks ``` Requires Node 18+. Everything else (yt-dlp, ffmpeg) is fetched or bundled automatically. ## Usage ```sh $ yoinks https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ # straight to the format picker $ yoinks # prompts for a url $ yoinks --theme light # force the light palette ``` yoinks takes over the terminal (full-screen, centered — and restores your scrollback on exit). Pick a format with ↑/↓ (or j/k, or number keys) and hit enter. `esc` goes back, `^c` quits. Or just use the mouse — the yoink button, the format list and the footer hints are all clickable, and clicking the logo takes you back home. Files are saved to `~/Downloads`, and the file path is printed to your terminal when you're done. The default `auto` theme uses your terminal's own foreground and background, so it follows light and dark terminal themes without guessing. Press `^t` or click the theme control in the footer to cycle through `auto`, `light`, and `dark` for the current session. Use `--theme auto`, `--theme light`, or `--theme dark` to choose the starting theme for one launch. ## How it works - Powered by [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp). On first run, yoinks downloads the standalone yt-dlp binary to `~/.yoinks/bin` — no Python required. If you already have yt-dlp installed, it uses yours. - ffmpeg (needed for merging high-res streams and mp3 extraction) is found on your PATH, with `ffmpeg-static` as a bundled fallback. - The UI is [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) — React for the terminal. ## Development ```sh npm install npm run build # bundle to dist/ with tsup npm run dev # rebuild on change node dist/cli.js npm run t

# DSH 大肥鱼 🐋 **在桌面上陪你工作的 DeepSeek Harness 伴侣。** [English](README_EN.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dafeiyu) · [下载最新版](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dafeiyu?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dafeiyu) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu)](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest)
大肥鱼由 DSH 插件启动，随 DSH 一起退出。透明、无边框、始终置顶的原生窗口，让你在编辑器、浏览器或其他应用中也能看到 Agent 的工作状态。 > **当前稳定版：0.1.22。** 新增「等待审批」提示音与按场景独立开关（完成 / 出错 / 等待审批）；macOS 上场景选择同时控制系统通知横幅，Windows / Linux 只播放声音。继续包含 0.1.21 的跨显示器拖动与菜单设置兜底、0.1.20 的透明区域点击穿透与 0.1.19 的 Helper 冷启动诊断。安装时填写 `dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.22`，离线安装请从[最新版下载页](https://github.com/QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu/releases/latest)选择 **`dsh-dafeiyu-0.1.22.tgz`**；Windows、Linux 与 macOS 共用这一个包。GitHub 自动生成的 **Source code (zip / tar.gz)** 是源码，不是安装包。 *原生 Windows 窗口实拍；余额为演示数据。当前角色素材来自 [PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)。* ## 能做什么 - 显示真实任务状态：思考、查找、修改、执行、验证、等待确认、完成和错误。 - 展示项目、步骤、多任务和 DSH 提供的待办进度；没有真实进度时显示阶段。 - 在状态气泡和设置页显示 DeepSeek 余额，区分 API Key 与已登录账户。 - 兼容 WebUI 与官方桌面端的共享客户端；两个客户端使用各自的插件配置。 - 支持拖动、摸头、戳身体、碰尾巴，以及大小、气泡、声音和减少动态设置。 - 可选在 DSH 页面右下角显示轻量角色，默认关闭。 状态来自 DSH 会话事件。大肥鱼不会读取屏幕；推理强度与进度只显示上游实际提供的信息。 ## 先选你的 DSH 客户端 | 使用方式 | 安装位置 | 设置入口（DSH 0.2） | 角色右键菜单的打开目标 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 浏览器 WebUI | `web` profile | 左侧插件 → dsh-dafeiyu | WebUI，默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080/` | | 官方桌面端 | `desktop` profile | 左侧插件 → dsh-dafeiyu | 通过 `dsh://open` 唤起桌面应用 | **WebUI 中安装的插件不会自动出现在桌面端。** 两边都启用会各自启动原生角色，可以在其中一个 profile 关闭“大肥鱼”。第三方桌面包装器可能仍使用 `web` profile，请以它的实际启动方式为准。 客户端包中的 `platform: web` 也适用于官方桌面端：官方 Electron 应用使用同一套 Web 客户端。原生角色由对应 Host 启动。 ## 安装 使用命令行安装、升级或移除前，先**完全退出对应 DSH Host**；操作后重新启动。通过桌面应用内的插件管理操作时，按应用提示重启。 ### 浏览器 WebUI 已全局安装 DSH： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.22 dsh web ``` 使用 `npx`，无需全局安装 DSH： ```powershell npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.22 npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web ``` 从 DeepSeek Harness 源码运行的用户，在 Harness 仓库中执行： ```powershell pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.22 pnpm dsh web ``` ### 官方桌面端 推荐直接在应用内安装： 1. 打开官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，点击左侧 **插件**。 2. 点击 **添加插件**，输入 `dsh-dafeiyu@0.1.22`，点击 **安装**。 3. 安装成功后点击 **立即启用**，大肥鱼会出现在桌面上。 4. 在插件列表打开 **dsh-dafeiyu**，调整角色、气泡和余额设置，修改实时生效。 这套流程使用桌面应用自带
